failure_modes.recovery: Close or fulfil an open signal first (market_signal_update status), then re-create.
failure_modes.when: all 8 signal slots are already open

preconditions: 8 open slots max per tenant — the cap forces signal quality and is server-counted.
Signals are visible ONLY to matched partners (the Discover feed), never to the whole network.

description: Post to one of the tenant's 8 market-signal wish-bar slots — a buy, sell, swap, capacity-offer or capacity-request visible ONLY to platform-matched partners, never the wider network. The door counts your OPEN signals server-side before writing: the 9th is refused with slots_used/slots_max in the error rather than silently queued. NEXT: market_signal_update to close or fulfil a signal and free a slot.
name: market_signal_create
